sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r6/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 38 / check 37; Internal Quality Checks row 38, no extra annotation)
evidence: Positives: state-relative wording is present throughout. app_context.md:30 says 'Do not assume the seed state'; functional prompt.md 'Task state and accounts' says criteria run in listed order against one database and must be judged 'against the state the earlier ones left'; polish and visual prompts say functional writes are legitimate; persistence step c records observed counts ('how many results', 'Dev's exact M-13 count', 'whether ... return anything'); unread uses 'at least 2' and 'read up to its newest message'; visual matter_sidebar tolerates absent unread counts; every criterion creates its own JUDGE probes, restores timers/walls it changes (timer_changes ends at 30 days, wall_added_live lifts, persistence lifts and resets), and a '-2' rerun rule exists. The hash-verified scripted golden run (functional-before/after.json, all true, in criterion order then polish) shows the conforming app tolerates the accumulated state; that is scripted, not a configured judge run. Defect: timer_changes step 5 (functional judge.toml criterion timer_changes) has Sian replay the timer request 'with 1 day' on M-13. If a weak app accepts it (missing partner check), the public rule 'Shortening a timer deletes whatever is now too old straight away' (walls-and-retention.md:23) deletes the seeded 'Draft will sent for your review.' (K-8, sent 2026-05-10T14:00Z, 45 h before the fixed clock). Two later criteria assume that seeded message still exists: message_links (copy the link of K-8; weight 1.5) and live_updates_keep_my_work (open the reply box on K-8; weight 1.5). The earlier criterion's mandated mutation therefore leaves a non-seed state that later criteria do not tolerate.
counterexample: Golden app with only the partner check at solution/app/server.js:471 removed. Expected: only timer_changes (4.0/42) fails. Actual on the shared DB: Sian's mandated 1-day replay is accepted, sweep() deletes K-8 immediately, then message_links cannot copy K-8's link and live_updates_keep_my_work cannot open its reply box on K-8, so both fail although their link-preview and live-update features are correct: an extra 3.0/42 of functional (~4.3% of total reward) lost from a single authorization bug. Secondary, not exercised: timer_changes and hold_scope_and_release consume one-shot seeded fixtures (probate K-13, Insurer letter K-17), so any retry of those criteria after a partial attempt could not re-pass; the '-2' rule covers only JUDGE texts.
suggested_fix: Make the refused timer replay non-destructive to later fixtures, e.g. replay with 'off' (or 7 days) and assert the setting still reads 30 days, or have message_links and live_updates_keep_my_work use a message they post themselves instead of seeded K-8.
